acceptance_tests: The bundle validates ready against the exact approved proposal SHA-256 before DSP edits begin.

Portable Core tests cover route selection, HOME behavior, destination-memory lock and erosion, block-invariant scheduling, waypoint validation, event snapshots, reset, panic, reseed, recall, silence, numeric safety, and fixed capacities.
Every Launch Control 3 channel, CC, value boundary, semantic transform, selection gesture, draft edit, capture action, and ignored-message result is exhaustively compared with control-map.json.

The frozen MM01 through MM10 render experiment produces deterministic route, event, metric, and stereo-audio artifacts at 48 kHz with no non-finite sample, overflow, capacity fault, or peak at or above 0.98.
Supported block partitions 1, 16, 64, 128, 511, and 512 preserve exact route/event traces and PCM for the same seed and semantic timeline on the authenticated environment.
The optional standalone compiles and links against the authenticated JUCE 8.0.15 tree without launching the app or opening an endpoint.

deliverables: A ready implementation bundle under research/prototypes/murmur-map/contract bound to proposal revision 0.1.
A noncanonical JUCE-independent C++17 Murmur Map Core with fixed-capacity route, destination memory, event scheduler, three voice lanes, accepted snapshots, and deterministic state operations.
An exhaustive regular Launch Control 3 semantic adapter and mapping tests, with controller edits terminating at public Murmur Map controls and drafts.
A deterministic offline renderer, MM01-MM10 comparator evidence runner, objective metrics, and retained reproducible manifests under build/murmur-map-evidence.
A private macOS arm64 JUCE 8.0.15 standalone map/editor with explicit MIDI input selection, refresh, receive diagnostics, and accepted-state feedback.
Prototype documentation, exact source dependencies and notices, topology/control descriptors, results, gaps, promotion needs, and implementation handoff.

schuss-source-release-000009@1 and packages/dsp_sources/mutable_stmlib_v1/SOURCE_PACKAGE.json remain the exact selected stmlib source authority and physical closure; distribution review remains required.
packages/dsp_adapters/mutable_braids_v1/ADAPTER.json and SchussMutableBraidsV1::Core are consumed byte-identically; Murmur Map adds no model or shared-adapter behavior.
schuss-source-release-000007@1 and research/prototype_support/instrument_lab/juce-8.0.15-source-tree.json are the sole JUCE source and complete-tree authorities; fetching is disabled.

research/prototype_support/controllers/novation-launch-control-3-regular-v1.json is physical topology authority only; Murmur Map owns labels, mappings, gestures, feedback, and draft/capture semantics.
SchussInstrumentLab::Core is linked from research/prototype_support/instrument_lab; no shared lab implementation is copied into the consumer.

goal.primary_claim: A visible, steerable route through performer-authored sound waypoints, with probabilistically replayed destinations and an exact lock, produces more coherent and controllable generative material than matched independent scene draws.
goal.why: Schuss already covers generative percussion, resonant counterpoint, drones, mutation textures, and sampling; Murmur Map tests a distinct screen-native melodic control-space instrument whose variation can be recognized, retained, and edited during performance.
